cmu_panoptic_main.description: Multi-person 3D pose estimation on CMU Panoptic with the paper's Table 1 protocol (AP at 25/50/100/150 mm MPJPE, recall at 500 mm, MPJPE over annotated joints). Hidden test: the standard test sequences 160906_pizza1, 160422_haggling1, 160906_ian5, 160906_band4 (100 evenly spaced frames each, 1367 people) seen by the paper's five HD cameras (3, 6, 12, 13, 23). Scaled setup: 2D detections come from a stochastic detector model applied to the real annotations instead of ViTPose on the videos, and each frame's people are rotated about the vertical axis by a hidden angle.
cmu_panoptic_main._note: compose and mvpose rows are the paper's Table 1 numbers (full Panoptic test set, ViTPose detections). The gym keeps the paper's sequences, cameras and metric protocol but replaces the image-based 2D detector, so absolute values are comparable in scale, not identical in setting. pairwise_baseline and mvpose_geometric are this gym's runnable baselines; their numbers come from scoring/scores_test.json.

ap_25mm.description: Average precision with a 25 mm MPJPE threshold: the strict localisation regime where the paper reports its largest gain over the pairwise optimisation baseline (37.63 -> 54.66).

ap_50mm.description: Average precision with a 50 mm MPJPE threshold.

ap_100mm.description: Average precision with a 100 mm MPJPE threshold.

ap_150mm.description: Average precision with a 150 mm MPJPE threshold (headline metric of the benchmark): correct people, correctly separated, no duplicates ranked above true poses.

recall_500mm.description: Constraint: share of annotated people that are the nearest person of some prediction within 500 mm, i.e. nobody is left out.

mpjpe_mm.description: Mean per-joint position error (mm) of the highest-scored prediction claiming each person within 500 mm; 500 when nothing is matched.
